observations: Photo 0 shows a PlayStation 5 console standing on a wooden surface with a controller in front; the console appears to be the slim-style PS5 (disc-less look not fully confirmable from these angles).
Photo 0 shows the front/side area and a visible power/port area, but no clear close-up of all ports.
Photo 1 shows the console with the controller in front; no clear view of model/serial label, storage size, or disc drive presence.
No photo shows the box, receipt, or any “pad” accessory clearly.

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS5 slim-style console and a controller, but the “pad” accessory is not clearly shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/inspection photos; cannot confirm opened/repaired status from the exterior.
No temperature/usage test or logs shown.
No close-up test of USB/HDMI/other ports; only partial port visibility.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No original pads or UK receipt are visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Disc drive vs digital version not confirmed (affects value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc slot area (or a close-up showing whether there is a disc drive) plus a photo of the console model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the less certain/worst-case variant for value (assume digital/unknown until confirmed).

risks.proof: Photo of the console settings screen showing storage capacity (or the model label with storage info).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lower storage option until proven.

risks.risk: “All ports working” not tested; possible faulty HDMI/USB ports.
risks.proof: Short video showing the console booting and using each port (USB device + HDMI to TV) with working output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst case: assume at least one port may be faulty).

risks.risk: Controller condition and whether it’s included as stated (and whether it’s original).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of controller model/label and buttons/analog sticks; show it pairing and working in-game.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may be worn/uncertain quality.

risks.risk: Receipt/accessories (“original pads”, UK receipt) may not be included.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual pads/accessories and the UK receipt (with sensitive info blurred).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (no receipt/accessories).

risks.risk: Console may have been opened/repaired or has hidden faults (fan noise, thermal paste, etc.).
risks.proof: Video of a full boot + a 15–20 minute gameplay/benchmark session with no shutdowns, plus a photo of serial/model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential hidden issues (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console model label/serial (photo of the sticker) and a photo showing whether it has a disc drive.
Photo of the console settings screen showing storage capacity.
Short video: console boots to home screen, HDMI output works, and USB ports are tested (plug a USB device).
Photos of the “pads” accessory and the UK receipt (receipt photo with personal details blurred).
Video showing controller pairing and working (buttons + analog movement).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5 slim-style console and a controller, but key details that determine the correct Oyo resale price (disc vs digital, storage size, and whether ports/accessories/receipt are truly included and working) are not verifiable from the provided images.
